create.title: Post-inner reduced-denominator shell support refinement
create.statement_tex: Fix W=Y^(7/16), D=Y^(1/2), L=Y^(1/6), one literal M1 or M2 fixed stratum, and one half-open inner reduced-denominator shell b' asymp B with D/L<=B<=D. After the exact Stieltjes thresholds have recombined to the physical complete-lift coefficient, support forces g asymp D/B and |a'| asymp LB/D, so for each outer ray the signed inner-numerator support has O(LB/D) integers. The Round-129 branch and divisor theorem gives K_B/L for each fixed outer ray and inner numerator, while outer Cauchy gives sum_r |A_i(r)|<<D. Consequently |O_(i,B)^+|<<_epsilon B K_B Y^epsilon, where K_B=min(Q_B,Q_B sqrt(lambda_B)+lambda_B^(-1/2)) asymp Y^(11/48+o(1)). Thus every range B<=D Y^(-sigma) gains Y^(-sigma) over D K_B, the smallest shell costs Y^(9/16+o(1)), and the complete block is localized to B asymp D. The top shell still costs Y^(35/48+o(1)), so the complete exponent and every global exponent remain unchanged. The support count is not asserted for each separated Stieltjes threshold atom.

create.title: Primitive top-shell determinant-residue bounded-multiplicity chart
create.statement_tex: After Möbius pieces are reassembled to the physical primitive inner ray, fix one primitive top-shell outer ray (a,b), put a'=a+p, b'=b+q, and n=ab'-a'b. Then n=aq-bp, b'={b(a+p)+n}/a, and n is congruent to -bp modulo |a|. If the literal p-support is a bounded union of intervals of total span O(|a|), as on the top shell |a| asymp L, every fixed n has O(1) admissible p-lifts and q is forced. Thus p is an induced determinant-residue lift rather than an independent Cartesian long variable. The statement is per fixed outer ray, top-shell only, and after physical reassembly; it does not bound multiplicity when the outer ray varies. The M1 denominator and M2 numerator characters pull back to induced residue weights, not automatically clean characters of n, and the same-denominator aligned packets show that bounded multiplicity alone gives no cancellation.
create.next_action: If this interface is reopened, write the exact induced M1/M2 residue weights including thresholds and owners, and prove a literal complete-class signed estimate. Do not assign an independent square-root gain to p.
